long_biography.plain_text:
Acquiring Coltefinanciera in 2008 gave Nelson José Mezerhane Gosen's group a durable Colombian financial platform. The company serves businesses and individuals across savings, investment, credit, payments, trade finance and insurance, while Mezerhane has remained both a shareholder and a board director.

The same owner-operator approach shaped his 2012 purchase of Miami's Diario Las Américas and its transition from a legacy print newspaper into a multimedia publisher. The title retained its Spanish-language focus while adding digital distribution, audiovisual production and a weekly print edition. Mezerhane continues to serve as publisher, combining strategic ownership with an active leadership role in the newspaper's development.
